newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Range-bound New Zealand dollar ends unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Range-bound New Zealand dollar ends unchanged.

text.p: The New Zealand dollar closed virtually unchanged from its opening on Tuesday after trading narrowly in a subdued market.
It ended at 5.00 p.m. (0500 GMT) at US$0.6912/19 while the Trade-Weighted Index finished at 67.73 versus a 67.60 opening.
The day's range was 0.6909-0.6925 and dealers doubted it would break those parameters on Wednesday.

They said the kiwi initially encountered selling out of Asia with Japanese names to the fore. But as it slipped to the bottom of its range U.S. investment house buying of kiwi, particularly against the Australian dollar, saw it rise again.
However, Australian dollar weakness pulled the kiwi down as well and dealers said that may hold the immediate key.

"We're very dependent on the aussie and we'll see whether this aussie can hold this US$0.7640-50 support line. If it can't, then kiwi I suspect will come under pressure in the next 24 hours," said a chief dealer.
